## 2. Full Request Flow

### Step-by-step through `{{PRIMARY_CLASS}}.{{PRIMARY_METHOD}}()`

<!--
Rules for this section:
- Number each major step with circled numbers ①②③...
- Show variable assignments at each step
- Show branching with ├─ (continue) and └─ (terminal)
- For each external call, show the class + file path
- For each cache lookup, show: hit → miss → fallback paths
- For each conditional, show BOTH branches
- End with the final response/output
- Minimum 8-10 steps for any non-trivial feature
-->

```
Incoming {{REQUEST_TYPE}}
        │
        ▼
① {{CLASS}}.{{METHOD}}({{PARAMS}})
   (class: {{RELATIVE_FILE_PATH}})
        │
        ├─ {{variable}} = {{expression}}         e.g. "path/to/extract"
        └─ {{variable}} = {{expression}}
        │
        ▼
② {{NEXT_CLASS}}.{{NEXT_METHOD}}()
   └─ {{CLASS}} (class: {{FILE_PATH}})
      │
      ├─ {{CACHE_OR_DB_LOOKUP}}
      │   ├─ Cache hit? → return immediately (no IO)
      │   ├─ Cache miss → {{FALLBACK_SOURCE}} read
      │   │               (result cached for {{TTL}})
      │   ├─ Not found → {{NOT_FOUND_BEHAVIOR}}
      │   └─ Found + active → continue ↓
      │
      ├─ {{CONDITIONAL_CHECK}}
      │   ├─ True → {{true_path}} [description]
      │   └─ False → {{false_path}} [description]
      │
      └─ Returns: {{RETURN_TYPE}} (immutable)
        │
        ▼
③ {{VALIDATION_OR_TRANSFORM_STEP}}
        ...
        │
        ▼
④ {{EXTERNAL_CALL}} (DB / cache / broker / API)
   └─ {{CLIENT_CLASS}} (class: {{FILE_PATH}})
      │
      ├─ Builds {{REQUEST_STRUCTURE}}
      └─ Executes: {{EXACT_CALL}}
         │
         └─ Returns: {{RESPONSE_STRUCTURE}}
        │
        ▼
⑤ Parse result → {{RESULT_TYPE}}
        │
        ├─ {{SUCCESS_PATH}} → {{success_action}} → {{FINAL_RESPONSE}}
        │
        └─ {{FAILURE_PATH}} → {{failure_action}} → {{ERROR_RESPONSE}}
```
